activation: ME_SHORT_A_FILL_CAPTURE_ENABLED=1 AND DB activation row status=RUNNING with explicit freeze_ts

activation_lifecycle.transitions: READY_TO_START -> RUNNING (explicit freeze) -> COMPLETED/CANCELLED; READY_TO_START -> CANCELLED; terminal states are final
activation_lifecycle.freeze_ts: immutable once set; capture requires strictly signal_time > freeze_ts

source: new prospective candidate, matched to source observation ids at capture time (source_observation_ids)
eligibility: every valid new MOMENTUM_EXHAUSTION SHORT candidate strictly after freeze_ts (reference_price > target_1 > 0 and invalidation_price > reference_price); no post-hoc signal filter
idempotency: event_key = sha256(symbol|SHORT|signal_time|reference|stop|target); ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; capture returns True only for a fresh insert
cost_estimate_model: cost_pct = (reference - estimated_fill)/reference + (ask - bid)/mid + 2*fee_per_side; cost_r = cost_pct * reference / structural_r; cost_class = NORMAL <= 0.0021 < ELEVATED <= 0.0031 < ABOVE_ELEVATED (frozen thresholds, classification only, never retuned)
scenario_semantics: per-scenario fill/slippage/cost/min-constraint feasibility in scenario_results; top-level feasibility_status mirrors the FIRST (base) scenario
exchange_constraints: minOrderQty/qtyStep/minNotional from Bybit /v5/market/instruments-info (lotSizeFilter, minNotional fallback minOrderAmt); BELOW_EXCHANGE_MIN when executable qty < minOrderQty or notional < minNotional; constraints_known=false rows are excluded from min-constraint analysis
book_source: Bybit /v5/market/orderbook category=linear limit=50, top bid/ask + bid depth within 10bps
note: No activation, no capture, no backfill until a separate deploy/freeze checkpoint. Paper/live forbidden. Frozen geometry A methodology is never modified by this audit.
